items.q: I had the pleasure of hearing guys like Lester Kerr... and his brother Gloster Kerr

ctx.x: In '41 I should have been 17. Yeah, at 17 I joined the union. So that put me, you know, into a little better class as far as for getting different kinds of jobs.

Yeah, I was still going to the Bandbox to latch on to different gigs. And I had the pleasure of hearing guys like Lester Kerr, who was a trumpet player, and his brother Gloster Kerr, and the great Cecil Lee, a trumpet player, and Russell Smith -- among some of the really great guys that I
